ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the whole figure contains four subfigures a, b, c, and d. The one directly corresponding to the "illuminance" and "net photosynthetic rate" in the question is Figure b; the horizontal axis of Figure b is labeled "light intensity/10^3 lx", and the vertical axis is "net photosynthetic rate". In Figure b, the curve first rises as light intensity increases, and then tends toward the highest plateau; the horizontal-axis reading corresponding to the highest value for the first time is about 12.5. Then reason: because the horizontal-axis unit is 10^3 lx, the horizontal-axis reading 12.5 should be converted to 12.5×10^3 lx. Therefore, in this study, the illuminance when the net photosynthetic rate reaches its maximum is 12.5×10^3 lx.
